comment: The module declares no parameters at all, so the operation can only be changed from the context menu; a reader who does not open it has a module that is permanently an AND gate. The panel prints A, B and OUT beside every gate with no number on any of them, while the maker's tooltips number them 1A, 1B, 2A and so on; the lines follow the panel and describe the one jack that was clicked. The high threshold is 1.2V rather than the 1V a Rack Schmitt trigger uses, and it is compared as a level every sample rather than as an edge, which is right for a logic gate. The normalling chain is the module's one hidden feature and nothing on the panel shows it: an unpatched A or B jack reads the same letter from the gate above, walking up until it finds a patched one or reaches the top, where it reads 0V. The plugin ships no source and no manual. The menu items are AND, NAND, OR and so on, under the label "Logic Operation".
